paragraphs: Rabbah bar Yitzhak, Rav's pupil. He reported teachings of Rav in Yevamot 71b; Hullin 45b; Bava Batra 77a; Kiddushin 27a: Rava bar Rav Yitzhak said that Rav said. Rav Yehudah told him—in the new Shas [שס״ח; specific edition uncollated], R' Yehudah, a scribal error—‘I shall explain R' Yohanan's reasoning to you’: Menahot 26b. He spoke to Rav Yehudah: Avodah Zarah 55a. Ravina accompanied Rava bar R' Yitzhak for four cubits; he came upon danger and was saved: Sotah 46b. See Ravina. Bava Batra 91a: Rabbah bar Rav Huna said that Rav said; another version is Rabbah bar Rav Yitzhak, as in Ein Yaakov.
